issues.detail: The Vietnamese 'bèn là' (then is/so is) incorrectly interprets the Greek 'αλλα' (allá - but) as a sequential connector. In the Greek, it is a contrast: 'not to people BUT to God'.

The Vietnamese translation omits the word 'πνευματι' (pneuma-ti), which specifies that the mysteries are spoken 'in [the] Spirit'. The current Vietnamese version only says 'trong Thánh Linh' (in the Holy Spirit) as a general location/manner, but it loses the specific grammatical connection of speaking *by means of* or *in* the Spirit as the source of the speech.
